significance: A Vaishnava temple at Brahmagiri, some 23 km from Puri, counted among the 108 Abhimana Kshetras. It is associated with Ramanujacharya's journey through Odisha and preserves a stone slab linked to Chaitanya Mahaprabhu's sankirtana.
story: Devotees say Jagannath directed Chaitanya Mahaprabhu here during Anavasara, the fortnight when the Puri image is withdrawn from view and the lord is believed to appear instead as Alarnath.
